8394809: G1: mark_clean_range_as_from_remset dirties already scanned cards

`mark_clean_range_as_from_remset` set any card bytes with their least significant bit set to `g1_from_remset_card`. This dirtied Clean cards as intended but also swept up `g1_card_already_scanned`.

Fix the behavior with some slightly more sophisticated bit twiddling.
